info.title: WeaveKit Engine REST API
info.description: The HTTP API exposed by `@weave-kit/engine`. Object routes are generic — `{name}` is an object from your `schema.json`. Every error response uses the same body: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "params?" } }`. Authentication is a bearer API key from `auth.source`, and RBAC is enforced in the data-access layer.

get.description: Returns one page of records. Row scope (`all`/`own`/`team`), field exclusions and sensitive-field masking follow the identity's RBAC.

post.description: Validates the body against the schema, runs RBAC and script hooks, and audits the write.

patch.description: Applies the same changes to every id in one all-or-nothing transaction.

delete.description: Deletes every id in one all-or-nothing transaction, subject to RBAC row scope.

get.description: A row outside the identity's row scope is reported as `404 data.recordNotFound` — it does not leak existence.

patch.description: Only fields the identity's `update` whitelist allows. Returns the updated record (with `warnings` when an after-hook warns).

delete.description: Deletes the record and returns `204` with no body.

put.description: Validates and atomically writes `schema.json`, then commits it.
Parses the JavaScript without executing it, writes the file and commits it.

get.description: Without `object`, returns `{ objects: [...] }` for every readable object; pass `object=<name>` for one. Responses carry an `ETag`.

get.description: Returns the static `mcp.identities` directory; a function resolver has no introspectable entries (`[]`).
A regular identity only sees its own events; roles in `adminRoles` may query any actor or the whole trail.
